whatIsResourceMapping.headline: What is Resource Mapping?
whatIsResourceMapping.description: Resource mapping is the process of capturing, analyzing, and visualizing physical and natural resources in a geospatial system to support planning, management, and decision-making.

items.title: Natural Resources
items.description: Forests, water bodies, soils, land cover

items.title: Infrastructure Assets
items.description: Roads, utilities, pipelines, buildings

items.title: Agricultural Systems
items.description: Crop zones, productivity mapping

items.title: Environmental Features
items.description: Wetlands, erosion zones, habitats

items.title: Urban & Rural Land Use
items.description: Settlement patterns, zoning systems

whatIsResourceMapping.closingStatement: It turns unknown landscapes into measurable, decision-ready datasets

typesOfResourceMapping.headline: Types of Resource Mapping We Deliver
typesOfResourceMapping.description: Comprehensive geospatial intelligence across four core domains

resourceMappingWorkflow.headline: Our Resource Mapping Workflow (Engineering Grade)
resourceMappingWorkflow.description: We follow a structured geospatial production pipeline:

steps.label: 1. Project Definition & Data Planning
steps.description:
Client requirements analysis
Area of interest (AOI) definition
Data acquisition strategy

steps.label: 2. Data Acquisition
steps.description:
UAV drone surveys (RGB, multispectral, LiDAR)
GNSS field data collection
Satellite imagery integration
Existing cadastral & base map integration

steps.label: 3. Data Processing & GIS Modeling
steps.description:
Orthomosaic generation
DEM / DSM / contour extraction
Spatial classification (land use / land cover)
Feature extraction & digitization

steps.label: 4. Spatial Analysis
steps.description:
Resource distribution modelling
Suitability analysis
Change detection (time-series analysis)
Hydrology & terrain modelling

steps.label: 5. Quality Control & Validation
steps.description:
Ground truthing
Cross-check with survey control points
Accuracy assessment reports

steps.label: 6. Final Delivery
steps.description:
GIS database (GeoPackage / File Geodatabase)
CAD drawings (DWG / DXF)
PDF thematic maps
Web GIS layers (optional)

deliverables.headline: Deliverables You Receive
deliverables.description: We deliver decision-ready geospatial intelligence, not just maps:

items.title: Geo-referenced GIS databases
items.description: Complete spatial databases with topology, attributes, and metadata ready for enterprise GIS deployment.

items.title: High-resolution orthomosaics
items.description: Seamless, georectified orthomosaics at 2–5 cm resolution for precise measurement and visual reference.

items.title: Digital Elevation Models (DEM/DSM)
items.description: Bare-earth DEMs and surface DSMs with contour extraction for terrain analysis and engineering design.

items.title: Land use / land cover classification maps
items.description: Standardized LULC classifications following FAO/ISO schemes with accuracy assessment reports.

items.title: Resource inventory datasets
items.description: Quantified resource inventories with spatial attributes for planning, valuation, and reporting.

items.title: Interactive Web GIS maps
items.description: Optional hosted web maps with layer toggles, measurement tools, and stakeholder sharing.

items.title: Engineering-grade PDF reports
items.description: Thematic map atlases with legends, scale bars, coordinate grids, and methodology appendices.

items.title: CAD-ready drawings for planners & engineers
items.description: Clean, layered CAD drawings with proper line weights, text styles, and coordinate systems.

agriculture.headline: AGRICULTURE
agriculture.description: SmartGrid Surveying enables precision agriculture by creating uniform spatial coverage across entire fields. This ensures consistent, comparable data that farmers and agronomists can act on with confidence.

items.title: Crop Health Monitoring
items.description: Drones equipped with multispectral cameras collect data across every grid cell, detecting stress, disease, or nutrient deficiencies early.

items.title: Soil Analysis & Zoning
items.description: Elevation and surface models generated through SmartGrid frameworks assist in creating drainage and irrigation zones.

items.title: Planting & Harvest Optimization
items.description: By mapping yield zones and growth patterns consistently over time, SmartGrid Surveying improves planning for sowing and harvesting.

utilitiesEnergySmartInfrastructure.headline: Utilities, Energy & Smart Infrastructure
utilitiesEnergySmartInfrastructure.description: Utilities and energy providers benefit from SmartGrid Surveying's systematic, scalable approach to mapping vast and often remote networks.

items.title: Powerline & Pipeline Corridor Mapping
items.description: RTK-enhanced drone flights along grid-aligned corridors reduce inspection time and improve spatial accuracy.

items.title: Solar & Wind Site Analysis
items.description: Evaluate terrain suitability, slope angles, and shade factors using SmartGrid elevation and exposure models.

items.title: Asset Management & Maintenance
items.description: Create digital twins of utility networks using consistent SmartGrid-collected data, improving inventory and maintenance tracking.

quarryMining.headline: QUARRY & MINING
quarryMining.description: SmartGrid Surveying provides a systematic method to monitor extraction sites and surrounding environments, delivering the spatial intelligence needed to operate efficiently and responsibly.

items.title: Topographic Mapping for Exploration
items.description: Generate high-resolution elevation models and terrain maps across large survey blocks with grid-based accuracy.

items.title: Volumetric Calculations
items.description: Track stockpile volumes and cut/fill operations with pinpoint precision using SmartGrid-based DEMs and 3D models.

items.title: Environmental Monitoring
items.description: Consistent grid coverage supports baseline mapping and post-mining land rehabilitation tracking.

constructionCivilEngineering.headline: Construction & Civil Engineering
constructionCivilEngineering.description: From pre-construction site analysis to post-construction documentation, SmartGrid Surveying accelerates workflows and ensures alignment with project specs.

items.title: Site Preparation & Earthworks
items.description: Accurate grading and leveling plans are developed using RTK-enhanced SmartGrid topographic data.

items.title: Progress Tracking
items.description: Grid-based drone flights can be repeated at scheduled intervals to produce visual and quantitative progress reports.

items.title: Utility & Infrastructure Mapping
items.description: SmartGrid coverage ensures that no asset is left unmapped—from roads to pipelines and power lines.

environmentalManagementConservation.headline: Environmental Management & Conservation
environmentalManagementConservation.description: With SmartGrid Surveying, environmental specialists can capture change over time, across space, and within specific ecological zones.

items.title: Forest & Vegetation Mapping
items.description: Uniform canopy height models and NDVI layers are derived from SmartGrid surveys for forest health assessments.

items.title: Watershed & Floodplain Analysis
items.description: DEMs generated from grid-based aerial surveys help model surface runoff, erosion, and water distribution.

items.title: Wildlife Habitat Monitoring
items.description: Consistent SmartGrid data ensures repeatable observations of protected or endangered habitats.

disasterRiskReduction.headline: Disaster Risk Reduction & Emergency Response
disasterRiskReduction.description: In areas prone to floods, landslides, or conflict, SmartGrid Surveying offers rapid, structured data collection to support planning and response.

items.title: Hazard Mapping & Risk Modeling
items.description: Build high-resolution DEMs to simulate water flow, slope instability, or fire spread patterns.

items.title: Damage Assessment
items.description: Conduct post-event surveys using the same SmartGrid flight plans to compare pre- and post-disaster conditions.

items.title: Infrastructure Recovery
items.description: Prioritize reconstruction efforts using accurate, up-to-date geospatial data with full area coverage.

items.title: Repeatable
items.description: The same SmartGrid layout can be flown repeatedly for reliable temporal comparisons.

items.title: Scalable
items.description: Whether it's a small farm or a national park, grid density can be adjusted to scale.

items.title: Compatible
items.description: Outputs integrate seamlessly with GIS, CAD, and modeling platforms.

items.title: Future-Proof
items.description: Grid-aligned datasets are ideal for feeding into AI and machine learning models for predictive analysis.
